svg.text: Drama triangle — present pattern and its origin
□ male · ○ female · ◇ other · ▭ system · ═ fused · zigzag = conflict · dashed = distant · ‖ cutoff · ⋯○ = origin (nested)
A shared map of roles to step out of, not a label for anyone. Supports, does not replace, care.
